title: The Cat in the Window
summary: A very short story about a cat's simple morning routine.

paragraphs.pt: Nina é uma gata branca. Ela mora com Pedro em um apartamento. De manhã, Nina fica na janela e olha a rua.
paragraphs.en: Nina is a white cat. She lives with Pedro in an apartment. In the morning, Nina stays at the window and looks at the street.

paragraphs.pt: Pedro dá comida e água para Nina. Depois, ele abre a porta da varanda. Nina gosta do sol. Ela dorme feliz no tapete.
paragraphs.en: Pedro gives food and water to Nina. Then he opens the balcony door. Nina likes the sun. She sleeps happily on the rug.

comprehension.question: What does Nina look at from the window?
